label: Pinterest
description_long:
Pinterest is a place of endless possibilities. You can:  
\- Discover everyday inspiration  
\- Shop styles you love  
\- Try and learn something new  
  
Create boards, save Pins and make collages of all your inspiration. Unlock billions of ideas, from fashion tips 👠 and easy recipes 🍜 to DIY projects 🛠️ and fresh ways to redo your space. Creating the life you love?  
  
It's Possible.

features.title: Content Discovery & Inspiration Browsing
features.description: The app provides access to billions of ideas across various categories such as fashion tips, recipes, DIY projects, and home decor, allowing users to find everyday inspiration.

inferences.reasoning: The feature allows access to remote content ('billions of ideas') and browsing, which fundamentally requires the application to open network sockets to fetch data from servers.

To provide a reliable content discovery experience, the app needs to monitor network connectivity status to determine availability for data retrieval and handle potential offline scenarios gracefully.
No permission required.
